fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: The check every 15 minutes. Off: saving removes its timer. On: saving puts the timer back.

groups.title: SMART counters
groups.help: Every drive in a bay. A rise is a warning; another soon after is an error.

fields.label: Watched attributes
fields.help: Any rise in one of these is a warning. Drives that are asleep are skipped, never woken.

fields.label: Error on a jump of
fields.help: A rise this big in one reading is an error at once. So is a counter that rises again before its alert clears.

fields.label: Clear after
fields.help: A SMART or btrfs alert clears after this many days with no further rise. A later rise opens it again.

fields.label: Never watch
fields.help: Drives to leave out, by serial number.

groups.title: Close to failing, checked at install
groups.help: The first reading only warns about drives already near these limits.

fields.label: Threshold margin
fields.help: Warn when an attribute's normalized value is within this much of the manufacturer's threshold.

fields.label: S5 limit
fields.help: Warn when S5 (reallocated sectors) is at least this.

fields.label: S187 limit
fields.help: Warn when S187 (reported uncorrectable) is at least this.

fields.label: S197 limit
fields.help: Warn when S197 (pending sectors) is at least this.

fields.label: S198 limit
fields.help: Warn when S198 (offline uncorrectable) is at least this.

groups.title: Arrays
groups.help: A parity check that finds mismatches is always a warning.

fields.label: Alert on degraded arrays
fields.help: UNAS already alerts when an array degrades. Yes: health-monitor does too, for data arrays only, and says when one has recovered.

groups.title: Heartbeat
groups.help: Empty: the shared heartbeat URLs in Notifications are used.

fields.label: Own heartbeat URL
fields.help: Pinged after every check that ends without errors, so this tool has its own check (a 15-minute period) apart from the others.

fields.label: Own heartbeat URL on failure
fields.help: Pinged instead when a check ends with errors. Used only with the own heartbeat URL.
